reason: The page intro says 83 melee and 72 ranged weapons, but those are totals: the Melee and Ranged navboxes list 83 and 72 pages including the unused Monkey Motivator and Spider Crossbow, which the page lists apart from the obtainable weapons; 82 melee + 71 ranged are obtainable.

The page intro says 46 artifacts, but Category:Minecraft Dungeons artifacts has 54 item pages: 45 in the list tables, 8 in the Unused table and the unused consumable Icon Map, which is categorised by mistake.
